T0558.title: Merchant Cash-Out
T0558.definition: A fraud pattern in which merchants use fake or circular transactions to convert payment channels into cash.
T0558.description: Merchant cash-out converts payment channels into cash through fake, circular, or related-party transactions. It may bypass payment risk controls, credit limits, or fund-use restrictions. Detection should examine merchant-buyer relationships, abnormal transaction structures, refund loops, fund return paths, and short-term high-frequency small transactions.
T0558.usageExample: Assess Merchant Cash-Out related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
